name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.suffix_tagP
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} {f0 f1 : List.{0} Bool → Option.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} α (List.{0} Bool))},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SuffixP f0 →
    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SuffixP f1 →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SuffixP (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.tagP f0 f1)

source.code:
theorem suffix_tagP {α : Type} {f0 f1 : List Bool → Option (α × List Bool)} (h0 : SuffixP f0)
    (h1 : SuffixP f1) : SuffixP (tagP f0 f1) := by
  intro l a rest h
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [tagP] at h
  | cons b l =>
      cases b with
      | false =>
          obtain ⟨pre, hpre⟩ := h0 l a rest h
          exact ⟨false :: pre, by rw [List.cons_append, hpre]⟩
      | true =>
          obtain ⟨pre, hpre⟩ := h1 l a rest h
          exact ⟨true :: pre, by rw [List.cons_append, hpre]⟩
